selected_primary_idea.title: Beyond the Current Pigment Library: A Calibrated Multiobjective Search for New Usable Reflectance Signatures
selected_primary_idea.summary: Construct a measured reference atlas and use safety-constrained, uncertainty-aware Pareto acquisition to prioritize pigment candidates. Novelty is operationalized against the declared library and CIE viewing conditions, never as a new fundamental human color.
selected_primary_idea.research_object: A compositional and structural candidate library paired with a commercial/reference pigment spectrum library.
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: A calibrated multiobjective acquisition policy produces a higher measured novelty-gate pass rate than random and color-distance-only baselines.
selected_primary_idea.mechanism: Joint modeling of spectrum-derived colour metrics, spectral-functionality proxies, stability proxy, composition constraints, and predictive uncertainty avoids one-dimensional color-distance optimization.
falsification_conditions: The selected batch does not outperform random or color-distance-only baselines on the preregistered pass-rate metric.
Calibration is inadequate on the held-out reference set.
No screened candidate improves the declared Pareto frontier after measurement and review.
Required safety/environmental review excludes the apparently promising candidates.
planned_contributions: An auditable definition of practical pigment novelty.
A spectrum-plus-CIE reference atlas under multiple illuminants.
A calibrated, constraint-aware Pareto ranking protocol.
A reporting grammar separating predicted, measured, reviewed, and commercial states.

competitive_ideas.title: Spectrum-first atlas of existing pigment materials
Coordination-environment rule mining
competitive_ideas.reason_retained: Mechanistic interpretability module for candidate explanations.

high_risk_ideas.title: Generative maximum-separation search
high_risk_ideas.risk: Likely to optimize visually distant but implausible or unusable candidates.

rejected_ideas.title: Search for a new fundamental human colour
rejected_ideas.reason: Contradicts the Survey's color-science invariant and is not an operational materials question.

mcts_evolution_summary.root_defect: The phrase 'new color' conflates perception with material novelty.
retained_edits: Replace universal novelty with a declared reference-set decision rule.
Replace hue-only optimization with a Pareto front.
Add uncertainty and composition/safety gates before selection.
Make measurement outcomes and negative results first-class outputs.
mcts_evolution_summary.discarded_edit: Treat a large predicted CIE distance as a discovery claim.
